veil_chroma_limit — DRIVE env op

• Data kinds: any × scalar → scalar

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.veil_chroma_limit(color, luminance: 'float', tol: 'float' = 0.15) -> 'float' (to call the implementation directly, import driveenv; driveenv.veil_chroma_limit(color, luminance: 'float', tol: 'float' = 0.15) -> 'float'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("veil_chroma_limit"))

Usage

For a lamp of color color (RGB ratio) and luminance luminance, the W* [cd/m²] at which adding white light W (veil, fog airlight) makes the chromaticity distance |(c L + W·1)/|c L + W·1| − c/|c|| (the same quantity as the chroma of balltrack.ball_detect) reach tol.

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

距離は W に単調に増える(W → ∞ で灰色 (1,1,1)/√3 との距離に漸近)。漸近値が tol 以下なら inf(どれだけ白を足しても色は読める)。二分法で相対 1e-12。使い道: 逆光の閾値 θ* = √(10 E_glare / W*)(Stiles–Holladay)、霧の中で色が読める距離 d* = ln(1 + W*/L_h)/β(灯火 c L e^{−βd} + 大気光 L_h (1 − e^{−βd}) の色度は c L + L_h (e^{βd} − 1)·1 と同じ)。
